items: 【Ultimate Android 15 OS】- The tablet runs the advanced Android 15 OS, which features enhanced privacy protection, app permission management, and accessibility features. It delivers superior security, customizable privacy controls, and a smooth multitasking experience. With excellent compatibility and a simple, guided setup process, it’s easy to use for all ages. Seamlessly supports the Google Play Store for convenient and secure app installation.

【24GB RAM & 64GB ROM & 1TB Expandable Storage】- Experience smooth, high-speed performance. Equipped with advanced 24GB RAM (4GB physical + 20GB virtual), multitasking and switching between apps is effortless. With 64 GB of internal storage and TF card expansion support up to 1 TB, you can securely store large quantities of photos, videos and files, putting an end to storage worries once and for all.

【10.1-inch HD Touch Screen】- Immersive audio-visual experience. Featuring a 10.1-inch high definition touch screen with the resolution of 1280 * 800, delivers natural colours and crystal-clear visuals. Has been certified for Widevine L1 technology, supporting HD content playback on major streaming platforms such as Netflix, YouTube, Disney+ and Hulu, providing a private, theatre-like viewing experience.

【High-efficiency productivity suite】- Your portable companion for work and study. It comes with practical accessories such as a Bluetooth keyboard, mouse and stylus, and can instantly transform into a lightweight laptop alternative for efficient document and email management. Bluetooth 5.3 and Wi-Fi 6 ensure stable, lag-free connections for accessories, with seamless on-the-go connectivity.（No charger included）

【Dual Cameras and Face Recognition】- Meet your work, study and security needs. With an 8MP rear camera and 2MP front camera, effortlessly handle video conferences, online classes or capturing life's moments. The newly added Face ID feature enables fast and secure device unlocking, protecting your privacy while delivering convenience.
